item.text: I’ll make the focused test-only refactor, first checking the current test structure and repository state, then running the affected Maven test if practical.
The clone is the initial `MigrationRule` creation plus its default `getForce` stub in the two specified tests. I’ll centralize exactly that default and leave the later per-scenario restubbing intact.

The refactor is applied. The Maven run reached test execution, but the environment reported access-denied warnings while closing a couple of local-repository JARs; I’m checking the final test report and diff rather than treating those warnings as a source change failure.
